newsitem.title: FINLAND: CUTS NOT ONLY WAY TO LOWER 98 SPENDING - PM LIPPONEN.
newsitem.headline: CUTS NOT ONLY WAY TO LOWER 98 SPENDING - PM LIPPONEN.

text.p: Finnish Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen said on Friday that a planned reduction in state budget spending next year by some 3.5 billion markka would be only partly reached with spending cuts.
"Cuts and pressing down total budget spending are not the same thing, cuts are only part of it," Lipponen told reporters after meeting representatives of local governments.
Lipponen said on Thursday the government should carry out proposals by the finance ministry which aimed to reduce spending to 188 billion markka from an earlier planned 191 billion.
He said postponing spending in some areas could contribute to lowering total expenditure.
The government is due to outline its budget in talks next week, from August 13 to 15.
